summary.text:
我们来为这个 PLC ST 功能块写逻辑。需要注意编辑环境只读，但用户要求只输出代码块，不需要修改文件。我们需要生成完整代码。先理解题目。

接口固定：FB，输入 Mode, ForwardButton, ReverseButton, SensorA, SensorB, SensorC, ButtonA, ButtonB, ButtonC；输出 MotorForward, MotorReverse, CompletionLight。需要 VAR 中间状态。

需求：手动模式 0=manual，1=auto。手动模式：ForwardButton 控制正转、ReverseButton 控制反转，互锁不能同时，且 N10-S7 要求手动恰有一个方向按钮时运行；如果同时按都不动作（虽然由互锁，但要求同时按不动作，那么逻辑是 forward only if ForwardButton AND NOT Reverse; reverse only if ReverseButton AND NOT Forward）。手动时还要清空自动流程。

自动模式：
- SensorA 检测到产品，ButtonA 触发后，电机正转移动到 B。
- SensorB 检测时电机停止；ButtonB 后正转移动到 C。
- SensorC 检测时电机停止；ButtonC 后 CompletionLight 亮；SensorC 消失后灯灭。

需满足形式性质，尤其 N10-S8/S9/S11/S12 涉及 prev 和 rising。需要跨周期记忆 prev Mode/MotorForward? 关键如何设计状态机，让灯及时亮。还需满足 S5：CompletionLight & X(!SensorC) -> X(!CompletionLight)，即如果当前灯亮且下一周期 SensorC false，下一周期灯必须灭。若灯在 ButtonC 后亮，此时 SensorC true，灭灯在下一周期 SensorC false。简单组合可满足：CompletionLight = Mode AND SensorC AND (prev? latch due processing complete). 不能用直接将 ButtonC 脉冲 latch，因为 N10-S10 要求 Mode AND SensorC AND prev(CompletionLight) -> CompletionLight，灯持续亮。S5 要求 SensorC false 立即灭。所以灯逻辑：CompletionLight := Mode AND SensorC AND (prevCompletionLight OR ButtonC)? 可是 S9 的时序特殊：从自动开始，经 A 确认、B 到位/确认、C 到位/确认连续五拍应点亮完成灯。这个可能期望当 ButtonC 到来时即使前五个时序满足，立即点亮。组合逻辑 ButtonC OR prev light 即可满足 S9 末尾条件? 前提 S9 前提复杂：Mode AND SensorC AND ButtonC AND prev(...). 所以 ButtonC 真时成立。灯 := Mode AND SensorC AND (CompletionLight_prev OR ButtonC)? S5: 如果传感器 false，不管 ButtonC 是否 true，灭。满足 N10-S10: Mode AND SensorC AND prev(CompletionLight) -> CompletionLight，如果 prev light true，则当前 true。 S4 满足。所以灯没问题。

电机正转自动逻辑：需要从 A 到 B 到 C 顺序，用状态机状态 StageA, StageB, StageC? 需要保持正转运行：N10-S12: Mode AND prev(Mode AND MotorForward) AND NOT SensorB AND NOT SensorC -> MotorForward。如果上一周期正转且下游 B/C 未到达，保持。这个要求避免脉冲。需要注意定义 prev(MotorForward) 在代码中用上一周期输出/状态，不能用直接当前。我们需要显式变量 last_MotorForward, last_Mode, maybe prevCompletionLight. 需要 edge first then update.

自动正转发起条件：A 确认后启动到 B：自动且 SensorA 且 ButtonA。B 确认后启动到 C：SensorB 且 ButtonB。需要停止条件：SensorB 到达停，SensorC 到达停。顺序推进可以状态机 stage: 0 waiting A confirm; stage 1 moving to B; stage 2 waiting B confirm; stage 3 moving to C; stage 4 completed/waiting C? 但没有必要输出前进持续？ 我们需要确保在从 A 到 B 期间，直到 SensorB 检测前保持正转，即使 ButtonA 可能释放。因此用状态机状态控制 MotorForward。例如：
- state=IdleWaitA (0): wait SensorA & ButtonA in auto -> state=MovingToB
- MovingToB (1): MotorForward TRUE; when SensorB true -> state=WaitB (2), MotorForward false
- WaitB (2): when ButtonB true and SensorB true? 需求 ButtonB after product at B; sensor must true. -> state=MovingToC (3)
- MovingToC (3): MotorForward TRUE; when SensorC true -> state=WaitC? Product at C, motor stop. Then ButtonC -> CompletionLight via logic (could state=AtC). Completion light independent.
- On exit auto to manual: reset state to initial; motor outputs manual.

但形式性质 N10-S11: 自动方式发出新的正转命令时，rising(MotorForward) -> (SensorA&ButtonA) or (SensorB&ButtonB)。状态转换当进入 MovingToB 时启转，当前 SensorA&ButtonA true；进入 MovingToC 时启转，当前 SensorB&ButtonB true。满足。需要确保 rising 检测不能错误。N10-S12 保持：MovingToB 直到 SensorB；MovingToC 直到 SensorC。状态机满足。

潜在问题：状态机加上 Cycle semantics LTL N10-S9 连续五拍 ===需要小心状态转换中 ButtonA 脉冲可能在等待状态不再保持；prev 链可能需要状态切换延迟。例如五拍：T0 Mode rising 且 SensorA & ButtonA; T1 Mode & SensorA & prev(...) etc. T2 Mode & SensorB & ButtonB & prev(传感器B和 prev...); T3 Mode & SensorB & prev(...); T4 Mode & SensorC & ButtonC & prev(...) -> CompletionLight T4. 如果状态机在 T0 进入 MovingToB，有可能在 T2 SensorB? 连续拍? S9 特设，可能验证组合时序。我们需确保 ButtonA 在 T0 触发后，在 T1 或后续是否还需要保留? 形式化 doesn't include actual motor movement sensor arrival speed, just sensor inputs at certain cycles.状态机 should allow N10-S9 sequence. We need examine all constraints to implement robust.

N10-S8: G((Mode AND NOT prev(Mode) AND SensorA AND ButtonA) -> MotorForward). On first auto cycle with A present+buttonA, motor forward true. State machine starts in IdleA; on Mode auto with SensorA&ButtonA -> MovingToB, output true same cycle. Good if prev(Mode) is computed last cycle before update.

N10-S9: "from automatic start through A confirmation, B arrival/confirmation, C arrival/confirmation continuous five beats should light completion lamp." LTL remains. Need parse: G((Mode & SensorC & ButtonC) AND prev(((Mode & SensorC) AND prev(((Mode & SensorB & ButtonB) AND prev(((Mode & SensorB) AND prev((Mode & NOT prev(Mode) & SensorA & ButtonA))))))))) -> CompletionLight. So sequence of five consecutive cycle conditions:
t0: Mode & !prev(Mode) & SensorA & ButtonA
t1: Mode & SensorA
t2: Mode & SensorB & ButtonB
t3: Mode & SensorC
t4: Mode & SensorC & ButtonC  -> CompletionLight at t4.
If our state machine: t0 Mode entered auto, sensorA&ButtonA -> MotorForward true, state MovingToB.
t1 Suppose SensorA true (as per condition), state remains MovingToB? We didn't transition until SensorB. Good.
t2 SensorB & ButtonB true; state should MotorForward maybe? On t2, product at B and button B. We can move to MovingToC same cycle, output forward true.
t3 SensorC true, state should stop moving? moving to C until sensor C true -> state WaitC, MotorForward false.
t4 SensorC & ButtonC true -> CompletionLight true. Good.

But N10-S11: rising(MotorForward) -> (SensorA & ButtonA) OR (SensorB & ButtonB). At t2 if we transition from MovingToB? Actually previous t1 MotorForward true; t2 SensorB&ButtonB true, if we remain forward, no rising. Should we stop at SensorB first? In sequence t2 says SensorB & ButtonB, previous t1 SensorB maybe? Conditions don't require SensorB at t1, but t2 first time? If t2 SensorB arrives and button active, could MotorForward was true already, no rising. N10-S11 plain.

Need consider auto motor logic can be simple state machine:
- If Mode false => clear auto state; MotorForward from manual.
- Else automatic:
  - Use state:
    CASE State OF
      0: # idle waiting A process
         if SensorA AND ButtonA THEN State:=1; MotorForward:=TRUE; else false
      1: # moving A->B
         MotorForward:=TRUE;
         if SensorB THEN State:=2; MotorForward:=FALSE;
      2: # at B waiting process
         MotorForward:=FALSE;
         if SensorB AND ButtonB THEN State:=3; MotorForward:=TRUE;
      3: # moving B->C
         MotorForward:=TRUE;
         if SensorC THEN State:=4; MotorForward:=FALSE;
      4: # at C
         MotorForward:=FALSE;
    END_CASE
But what if after state 0 and ButtonA releases before SensorB? We enter state1 latch, so okay. What if SensorB and ButtonB at same cycle immediately after A confirm? Not realistic but could transition from state0 directly? state0 only checks A button; if SensorB true too under auto maybe should stop? We can prioritize downstream sensor? Need robust.

S6 says automatic order A->B->C; B/C sensor detects stop, ButtonB continue, C button complete. If product already at SensorB on entering auto without A confirm, should not move. Our state waits A. But what if after A confirm and SensorA true + SensorB maybe true (sensor overlap)? We go state1 then next cycle state1 sees SensorB and stops. That's okay one cycle forward though product already B? No big.

But N10-S12 requires if MotorForward and downstream B,C absent, keep. State1&3 do.

Interlock: final output should ensure not both. Manual: if Mode false and not both, outputs. Automatic outputs MotorForward; MotorReverse should be false in auto. Output interlock can be implemented by assigning separately ensuring exclusivity: if mode then F=autoF; R=FALSE else F=(Fwd & !Rev); R=(Rev & !Fwd). Since mutual.

CompletionLight as above: CompletionLight := Mode AND SensorC AND (prevCompletionLight OR ButtonC); But what about S9 immediate after state4? yes.

Need prev variables:
- prev_Mode: BOOL;
- prev_MotorForward: BOOL? N10-S12 and N10-S11 perhaps use rising of actual MotorForward. Need compute rising using lastcycle output before updating history.
- prev_CompletionLight: BOOL.

But N10-S12: `prev(Mode AND MotorForward)` means previous cycle (Mode & MotorForward). We can use prev_Mode_and_MotorForward variable or compute prev_Mode AND prev_MotorForward. If Mode in previous cycle and MotorForward previous cycle. Update history at end.

Rising: `rising(MotorForward)` = MotorForward AND NOT prev_MotorForward. We can enforce. Our state transitions inherently satisfy? Let's see State 0 ->1 at SensorA&ButtonA: MotorForward old false, current true => rising true and conditions true. State2->3 at SensorB&ButtonB likewise. State1? when SensorB true: previous forward true, current false; no rising. State3 to 4 no rising. So property N10-S11 satisfied. Manual mode could produce rising from button press but property antecedent Mode false so vacuously. N10-S12: in states 1/3, previous Mode & MotorForward true, if no SensorB/C, current true (unless state changed due button? In state1 no button matters; only SensorB stops. In state3 only SensorC stops). Good.

Need handle Mode and Sensor inputs transitions.

Potential issue with N10-S8 and reset: On entering manual mode, clear automatic flow. State:=0. Manual outputs. `prev(Mode)` update end.

Need formal property S2: MotorForward -> (Mode | ForwardButton). Manual forward only if ForwardButton true and not reverse. Auto. ✓. S3: MotorReverse -> (!Mode & ReverseButton). In manual reverse only if ReverseButton & !Forward; auto false. ✓ though S3 says `(!Mode & ReverseButton)` must satisfy; our reverse also requires not forward, which is subset, so okay. S7 manual exactly one direction: if ForwardButton and not Reverse -> MotorForward; yes. if Reverse and not Forward -> MotorReverse; yes. If both true -> both false because each condition requires NOT other. Interlock by logic plus final `AND NOT MotorReverse` etc? We can ensure.

Question: Should outputs be directly assigned in each scan, not latched by extra. We can do local variables autoForward, etc then outputs.

Need beware CODESYS syntax: FB can have local VAR variables. Names no conflict. CASE ... OF. Use `ELSIF`. No need `METHOD`. Need END_CASE;I'll write code carefully; only output st code block. Since user explicitly says no explanation outside code, final must be only code block. No preamble.
